summary: This video demonstrates a high-end Thunderbolt team competing in the Crown Contest against level 300 Fire Elemental Guardians (Fire Fortress). The team achieved a total damage score of over 6.12 billion within the 5-minute time limit. Perkunte acts as the primary carry, delivering approximately 75% of the total team damage. Detailed stat profiles and gearing directions are displayed for all five team members at the conclusion of the battle.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Dealt 4.58 billion damage (74.9% of total team output), built with full Enlightenment and Attack.

heroes.name: Sha'nachtan
heroes.note: Contributed 747.8M damage (12.2% of total damage) and was geared with high Accuracy.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Provided 74.8M total healing and 480M damage, built with high HP and Accuracy.

heroes.name: Alaura
heroes.note: Contributed 198M damage to support team mechanics, built with full Enlightenment.

heroes.name: Tariz
heroes.note: Dealt 113.4M damage while ensuring reliable debuff application by prioritizing Accuracy.

teams.note: Achieved 6,128,604,979 total damage against level 300 Fire Elemental Guardians.

tips: Build Perkunte with full Enlightenment and Attack to maximize Thunderbolt damage scaling.
Prioritize HP and Accuracy on Maashtur so he can reliably sustain the team and absorb hits.
Build sufficient Accuracy on Tariz and Sha'nachtan to consistently land debuffs on boss targets.
Stack Enlightenment on Alaura to boost team utility and secondary Thunderbolt output.
title: Thunderbolt Team (lvl 300) vs Fire Guardians | Crown Contest | Dragonheir | Season 8
